scenes.description: Benny Checking the Big Colorful Wall Calendar for Monday
Excited Kids Circling Saturday and Sunday for the Weekend
Celebrating Birthday Month in July with Balloons and Cakes

character_line.en: A brand new week begins! What day is today?
character_line.zh: 全新的一週開始了！今天是星期幾呢？

options.en: Today is Monday! We go to school!
options.zh: 今天是星期一！我們要去上學！

options.hint: 一星期的開始是星期一「Today is Monday」喔！
看看日曆上的第一天，告訴 Benny 今天是星期一吧！

character_line.en: Monday is great! What special class do we have on Tuesday?
character_line.zh: 星期一很棒！我們星期二有什麼特別的課程呢？

options.en: We have fun music class on Tuesday!
options.zh: 我們星期二有好好玩的音樂課！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 星期二有大家最喜歡的音樂課「music class」喔！
星期二我們能開心地唱歌演奏樂器喔！

character_line.en: Five days of school are done! Which days are the weekend?
character_line.zh: 上學五天結束了！哪兩天是週末呢？

options.en: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend!
options.zh: 星期六和星期日是週末！

options.hint: 週末是星期六和星期日「Saturday and Sunday」喔！
告訴 Benny 哪兩天可以放假跟家人一起去公園玩吧！

character_line.en: Hooray for the weekend! What do you like to do on Sunday?
character_line.zh: 太棒了放假了！你星期日喜歡做什麼呢？

options.en: I love to ride my bike in the park on Sunday!
options.zh: 我星期日好喜歡在公園騎腳踏車！

options.hint: 分享你星期日喜歡在公園騎腳踏車「ride my bike」喔！
告訴 Benny 你在週末最喜歡做的戶外活動吧！

character_line.en: Look at the big numbers on July! Why is there a birthday cake drawn here?
character_line.zh: 看看七月份上的大數字！為什麼這裡畫了一個生日蛋糕呢？

options.en: Because July is my birthday month!
options.zh: 因為七月是我的生日月份！

options.hint: 七月畫著蛋糕是因為那是你的生日月份「birthday month」喔！
開心告訴 Benny 七月是慶祝生日的月份喔！

character_line.en: Happy birthday month! How many months are in a whole year?
character_line.zh: 生日月快樂！一整年總共有多少個月份呢？

options.en: There are twelve months in a year!
options.zh: 一年總共有十二個月份！

options.hint: 一整年總共有十二個月份「twelve months」喔！
數數看從一月到十二月總共有幾個月吧！
